d:
Enna Solla composed by Anirudh Ravichander in the lyrics of Dhanush and the voice of Shweta Mohan for the film Thangamagan, is a breath of fresh air and is sure to get stuck in your head all day long.
Song Name - Enna Solla
Movie - Thangamagan
Singer - Shweta Mohan
Music - Anirudh Ravichander
Lyrics - Dhanush
Director - Velraj
Starring - Dhanush, Amy Jackson, Samantha
